sn35.75:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu …pe… bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.75:1.2: amukasmiṃ bhante vihāre aññataro bhikkhu navo appaññāto ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
sn35.75:1.3: sādhu bhante bhagavā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn35.75:2.1: atha kho bhagavā navatarañca sutvā gilānatarañca appaññāto bhikkhūti iti viditvā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami.
sn35.75:2.2: addasā kho bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ
sn35.75:2.4: atha kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn35.75:2.5: alaṃ bhikkhu mā tvaṃ mañcake samatesi
sn35.75:2.7: nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. nisajja kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn35.75:2.8: kacci te bhikkhu khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti paṭikkamo sānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
sn35.75:3.1: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ …pe…
sn35.75:3.2: na kho me bhante attā sīlato upavadatīti.
sn35.75:4.1: no ce kira tvaṃ bhikkhu attā sīlato upadavati atha kismiṃ ca te kukkuccaṃ ko ca vippaṭisāroti.
sn35.75:5.1: na khvāhaṃ bhante sīlavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn35.75:6.1: no ce kira tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlavisuddhatthaṃ mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi atha kimatthaṃ carahi tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsīti
sn35.75:7.1: anupādāparinibbānatthaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn35.75:8.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu anupādāparinibbānatthaṃ mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi
sn35.75:8.3: anupādāparinibbānattho hi bhikkhu mayā dhammo desito.
sn35.75:11.9: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti.
sn35.75:13.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.75:15.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn35.75:15.2: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn35.75:17.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati …pe…
sn35.75:17.5: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayidaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn35.75:17.6: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.75:17.7: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
sn35.75:18.2: attamano so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi.
sn35.75:18.3: imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhussa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatīti.
